refusedRetryMinutes.label: Ask the ERP again for a refused order at the latest after (minutes)
refusedRetryMinutes.help: An order the ERP refused for now (short of stock, or a product without a shop price yet) waits and goes again by itself once the stock or the price is there. This is the longest it waits before the shop asks again anyway.

catchUpDays.label: Check open orders with the ERP for (days)
catchUpDays.help: The shop reads the ERP's own copy of its open orders from these last days, so a lost message about a short or filled line is never missed.

catchUpBatch.label: Orders checked with the ERP per run
catchUpBatch.help: How many open orders one check reads from the ERP.
